name: Triage support tickets with Jev and draft replies behind Jev guardrails
description: Asks TypeSafe Jev three typed questions about every incoming support ticket in one call - is it urgent, which team owns it, how frustrated is the customer - and routes it on the answers. An AI agent drafts the first reply behind Jev input and output guardrails, which stop prompt injection and unsafe answers without a second chat model. Urgent or angry tickets are also escalated.
shortDescription: Classify, route and escalate support tickets with TypeSafe Jev, and draft guarded first replies.
keyFeatures: One TypeSafe Jev call answers three typed questions: urgency (Noul), team (Choice) and frustration (Score)
Routes on Jev's confidence: an unsure team choice goes to a person instead of the wrong queue
Jev input and output guardrails block prompt injection and unsafe drafts without a second chat model
Escalates urgent or very frustrated customers to a separate Slack channel
prerequisites: A TypeSafe AI API key (https://typesafe.ai) in a TypeSafe AI connection, used by the Ask Questions step and both Jev guardrails
An Anthropic connection for the agent's model
A Slack connection and five channels (billing, technical, sales, triage, escalations) with the ByteChef app invited; replace the placeholder channel names
A deployed project with this workflow enabled, so the webhook URL accepts tickets
idealFor: Support teams that want every ticket classified, routed and answered in seconds, with AI replies that cannot be hijacked by the ticket text.
steps: Trigger: a webhook receives a ticket as JSON with ticket and customer.
Ask TypeSafe Jev whether the ticket is urgent, which team owns it and how frustrated the customer is, in one call.
Draft a first reply with an AI agent whose Jev input and output guardrails block injection attempts and unsafe answers.
If Jev is confident about the team, post the ticket, the answers and the draft to that team's Slack channel; otherwise ask a person in the triage channel.
If the ticket is urgent or the customer is very frustrated, also post it to the escalations channel.
